limits: Shares among nonblank interpretable facility lists; not physical on-site ownership or absence.
Current lists by approval era, not original installation, adoption dates, opening or quality.
Dictionary labels are literal. 문고 is not 독서실; 골프장 is not 골프연습장.
The official facility form covers facilities within or around a complex; registration is not exclusive access.
Missing lists, missing historical columns, unmatched registrations and year mismatches are retained as unknown.
Basic and registered populations are distinct. Coverage is shown for units and known households separately.
Bands include the lower endpoint and exclude the upper endpoint except 100. A zero-starting band is not absence.
Withheld is not zero. No exact counts, individual identities, fees, facility quantities or transaction selections.
